regions.name: Sampit
regions.quote: Type locality is 'About 50 to 100 kilometers north of Sampit, Kalimantan, Indonesia', which presumably refers to the Sampit (aka Mentaya) River basin while the only other details available suggest that it's also been collected from the Mahakam drainage.
